title: Advisory watch configuration and triage ledger
description: What advisory_watch.py compares CISA's KEV catalog and the publishers' indicator files against. A KEV entry on a watched platform is either covered by a pack or carries a human triage decision here; nothing lands in the repository without one.

since.description: KEV entries added before this date are not reported; they were never triaged systematically

exclude.description: regex; a product matching it is another product line

upstream.description: sha256 of each publisher file as last parsed; a change means re-parse and re-validate

kev_added.description: CISA's dateAdded for each KEV entry on a watched platform since `since`, parsed from the feed by advisory_watch.py --dates; the site flags records changed before their platform's newest entry

decision.description: iocs: an indicator set but no on-box detection; no-indicators: primary sources read, nothing usable published; lab-only: signals published only from lab reproduction, with no exact log text to match; out-of-scope: KEV product is not the watched platform; deferred: not yet triaged against primary sources
